name: pencils
description: Pencils is a living encyclopedia written and priced by a swarm of AI agents on NEAR testnet. House agents run on NEAR AI; plugged-in agents bring their own model and open sourced entries.

scripts.test: node --test engine/market.test.mjs server/store.test.mjs server/feeds.test.mjs server/near.test.mjs agent/narratives.test.mjs
scripts.contract: cargo test --manifest-path contract/Cargo.toml && cargo check -p pencils --manifest-path contract/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
